Overwatch Actors Talk Community Building & Role Playing Characters in Character | Blizzcon 2026
We chat with the Voice Actors of Questwatch an Overwatch-themed tabletop roleplaying game experience that originated as a limited-time game mode in Overwatch 2 Season 5 and expanded into a live-play event at BlizzCon 2026. Learn more about Matt Mercer, Anjali Bhimani, Darin De Paul, Chiara Preziosi, and Carolina Ravassa's early gaming inspiration, role playing other characters and more!
